checks.evidence: Identify, prioritize, and fix 170+ SEO issues. Keep your website in top shape for users and search engines.

checks.title: Heading hierarchy
checks.fix: Do not skip heading levels. Outline the page H1 > H2 > H3 so search engines and AI can parse the structure.

checks.title: Keyword alignment
checks.fix: Put the primary keyword in the title, the H1, the URL slug and the first 100 words.

checks.title: Image alt text
checks.fix: Write descriptive alt text for every image — it feeds image search, accessibility and AI understanding.

checks.title: Structured data present
checks.fix: Add JSON-LD: Organization on the homepage, Product/Service on offer pages, BreadcrumbList sitewide, Article on blog posts.

checks.title: Text-to-HTML ratio
checks.fix: Reduce markup around the content: fewer wrapper divs, less inline CSS/JS.

checks.title: Trust pages exist
checks.fix: Publish About, Contact, Privacy Policy and Terms pages. They are E-E-A-T signals and AI engines check them before citing a source.

checks.title: FAQPage schema
checks.fix: Add FAQPage JSON-LD with 5-10 real customer questions and concise answers. This is the single highest-leverage AEO change.

checks.title: HowTo schema
checks.detail: No HowTo schema (only needed if you publish step-by-step guides)
checks.fix: For any process/installation/guide page, add HowTo JSON-LD with numbered steps.

checks.title: Question-form headings
checks.fix: Rewrite or add H2/H3 headings as real questions ("How much does X cost?", "What is the difference between X and Y?"). These are what People Also Ask pulls from.

checks.title: Answers are 40-60 words
checks.detail: No question/answer pairs detected on the page
checks.fix: Add a FAQ section: question as the heading, 40-60 word answer immediately below.

checks.title: Bulleted / numbered lists
checks.fix: Convert features, specs, steps and options into bullet lists. Lists are far easier to lift into an answer box.

checks.title: Tables for comparison
checks.fix: Add at least one comparison or specification table. Tables are prime snippet and AI-summary material.

checks.title: Person schema
checks.fix: Add Person JSON-LD with name, jobTitle, url and sameAs (LinkedIn, X/Twitter). This is how an AI engine connects your content to a real entity.

checks.title: Organization / LocalBusiness schema
checks.fix: Add Organization (or LocalBusiness with address, phone and openingHours) JSON-LD on the homepage. Without it, AI engines cannot confidently attribute your content to your brand.

checks.title: Publish / update dates
checks.fix: Add visible and machine-readable publish and last-updated dates.

checks.title: Content type schema

checks.title: Machine-parseable formatting
checks.detail: No tables or lists on the page
checks.fix: Use tables for comparisons and specs, and lists for options and steps. Plain prose is much harder for an AI to lift cleanly.

checks.title: Q&A pairs for summarisation
checks.fix: Add an FAQ block. It is what Perplexity and AI Overviews quote most often.

checks.title: Semantic HTML landmarks

quick_wins.title: Quantitative facts

quick_wins.title: Named author

quick_wins.title: Person schema
quick_wins.action: Add Person JSON-LD with name, jobTitle, url and sameAs (LinkedIn, X/Twitter). This is how an AI engine connects your content to a real entity.

quick_wins.title: Content type schema
quick_wins.action: Declare what each page is with Article, Product or Service JSON-LD so AI engines know which passages answer which kind of question.

quick_wins.title: Publish / update dates
quick_wins.action: Add visible and machine-readable publish and last-updated dates.

quick_wins.title: Q&A pairs for summarisation
quick_wins.action: Add an FAQ block. It is what Perplexity and AI Overviews quote most often.

quick_wins.title: Machine-parseable formatting
quick_wins.problem: No tables or lists on the page
quick_wins.action: Use tables for comparisons and specs, and lists for options and steps. Plain prose is much harder for an AI to lift cleanly.

quick_wins.title: Keyword alignment
quick_wins.action: Put the primary keyword in the title, the H1, the URL slug and the first 100 words.

quick_wins.title: Structured data present
quick_wins.action: Add JSON-LD: Organization on the homepage, Product/Service on offer pages, BreadcrumbList sitewide, Article on blog posts.

quick_wins.title: Trust pages exist
quick_wins.action: Publish About, Contact, Privacy Policy and Terms pages. They are E-E-A-T signals and AI engines check them before citing a source.

quick_wins.title: Image alt text
quick_wins.action: Write descriptive alt text for every image — it feeds image search, accessibility and AI understanding.

quick_wins.title: Render-blocking head resources
quick_wins.action: Defer non-critical JS and inline critical CSS. Every blocking file in <head> delays first paint.

high_impact.title: FAQPage schema
high_impact.action: Add FAQPage JSON-LD with 5-10 real customer questions and concise answers. This is the single highest-leverage AEO change.

high_impact.title: Answers are 40-60 words
high_impact.problem: No question/answer pairs detected on the page
high_impact.action: Add a FAQ section: question as the heading, 40-60 word answer immediately below.

high_impact.title: Question-form headings
high_impact.action: Rewrite or add H2/H3 headings as real questions ("How much does X cost?", "What is the difference between X and Y?"). These are what People Also Ask pulls from.

high_impact.title: Organization / LocalBusiness schema
high_impact.action: Add Organization (or LocalBusiness with address, phone and openingHours) JSON-LD on the homepage. Without it, AI engines cannot confidently attribute your content to your brand.

nice_to_have.title: Answer-first intro
nice_to_have.action: Open with a 40-60 word paragraph that directly answers the page's main question, then expand.

nice_to_have.title: Bulleted / numbered lists
nice_to_have.action: Convert features, specs, steps and options into bullet lists. Lists are far easier to lift into an answer box.

nice_to_have.title: Tables for comparison
nice_to_have.action: Add at least one comparison or specification table. Tables are prime snippet and AI-summary material.

nice_to_have.title: Heading hierarchy
nice_to_have.action: Do not skip heading levels. Outline the page H1 > H2 > H3 so search engines and AI can parse the structure.

nice_to_have.title: HowTo schema
nice_to_have.problem: No HowTo schema (only needed if you publish step-by-step guides)
nice_to_have.action: For any process/installation/guide page, add HowTo JSON-LD with numbered steps.

nice_to_have.title: Semantic HTML landmarks
nice_to_have.action: Wrap content in <main> and <article> and use <nav>. Landmarks help extraction pipelines isolate the real content from the chrome.

nice_to_have.title: Sitemap lastmod dates
nice_to_have.problem: No <lastmod> values found in the sitemap
nice_to_have.action: Add accurate <lastmod> dates so crawlers can prioritise changed pages.
